entries.title: Global floating toolbar
entries.impulse_target: role-aware header, menu and local navigation
variants_to_capture: keyboard focus and Escape where applicable
entries.measurement_targets: outer bounds; toolbar/sidebar insets; sticky offset; translucent area; safe-area margin; icon and label alignment
entries.behavior_acceptance: Keep the product owner's hidden-at-rest menu and every role-permitted route; no replacement with unrelated navigation.
